confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated crowdsourced Kenting data from Traveltables and Nomad Watch. Those figures are thin and partly dated (Traveltables last updated July 2023), so I adjusted them upward a little for inflation and for July peak-season tourist pricing. Beer at USD 3.80 is set between Traveltables' USD 2.14 per 0.5 L draught and Nomad Watch's USD 3.13 per pint, reflecting beachfront and Main Street pricing. Cocktail and wine have no Kenting-specific data, so they are estimated from the local price relationship to beer and from Taiwan-wide bar pricing; they are the least certain drink anchors. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, assuming July is peak beach season in Kenting with notably higher weekend and summer rates. No booking pages or listings were checked. The FX rate is the RBA 18 Nov 2026 AUD/USD figure as shown in a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct read of the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored on Kenting-specific crowdsourced data and cross-checked against Taiwan-wide and Kaohsiung/Taipei price levels. Kenting is a seasonal beach resort town, so restaurant and drink prices sit at or slightly above Kaohsiung levels, and summer accommodation carries a resort premium.
